name: Leg Length Discrepancy
definition: Difference in length between lower limbs due to congenital, developmental, traumatic, infectious or neurological causes.

typical: Back or lower-limb fatigue when significant

investigations.principle: Standing scanogram/EOS or calibrated long-leg imaging quantifies true discrepancy and projected growth.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, physeal, occult injury, deformity or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

green: Shoe lift for selected small symptomatic discrepancies
amber: Epiphysiodesis, lengthening or shortening procedures depend on predicted discrepancy and age.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada/Jangha asymmetry may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Difference in length between lower limbs due to congenital, developmental, traumatic, infectious or neurological causes.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, open injury, severe deformity, rapidly progressive neurological symptoms, suspected infection or other listed red flags.
